comments.text:
Completed implementation of the vantablack theme:
- Added standalone static/themes/vantablack.css based on Antharchy/Omarchy vantablack color palette.
- Added "vantablack" to AVAILABLE_THEMES in markusmd.themes.
- Added [data-theme="vantablack"] styles to static/markus.css.
- Added BDD feature scenarios in features/themes.feature and updated features/site.feature.
- Verified with behave (all 135 scenarios passing), ruff lint, and demo site build.
